title: Het moderne Egypte: Wat er te zien en te hooren valt tusschen Kaïro en Faschoda De Aarde en haar Volken, 1908

The author, eager to explore and share impressions of the country, acknowledges the complexity of Egypt's political issues but opts to focus on his personal experiences instead. Upon arrival in Alexandria, the author is immediately swept up in the hustle and bustle of the port, illustrating the vibrant, chaotic scene filled with locals and tourists alike. The narrative unfolds as the author travels by train through lush landscapes, remarking on the rapid modernization of Cairo and the mix of Eastern and Western cultures that characterize the city.
